title: Scripture on Judas: Spirit, David, and the Savior's voice
english: [[Scripture had to be fulfilled >> Bible:Acts 1:16]] which the Holy Spirit foretold through David's mouth concerning Judas—the psalm in which the things about Judas are written.

Someone might object that it is not the Holy Spirit speaking, since the words are plainly the Savior's: "[[O God, do not keep silent at my praise; for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful have opened against me >> Bible:Psalm 109:1-2]]," and so on through "[[let another take his office >> Bible:Psalm 109:8]]."
How then, if the Savior is the speaker, does Peter say that Scripture had to be fulfilled which…

title: The Spirit personifies God in the prophets
english: …which the Holy Spirit foretold through David's mouth? Perhaps what we are taught here is this: the Holy Spirit uses personification in the prophets.
And if the Spirit personifies God, it is not God who is speaking, but the Holy Spirit…

title: Speaking from God's person and from Christ's
english: …speaks from the person of God; and if the Spirit personifies Christ, it is not Christ who is speaking, but the Holy Spirit speaking from Christ's person. So…

title: Whatever persona, the Holy Spirit is the speaker
english: Even when the Spirit personifies the prophet, or that people, or this people, or any other role, it is the Holy Spirit who carries out every personification.
